spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous spacing. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full to stretch children.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and data. Use optical alignment for buttons with icons.

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens.
surfaces.header: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. Sticky positioning with z-50.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have explicit hover states (color change, subtle transform).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties like transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.

component_instructions.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with clear branding, 3-5 links, and primary CTA if needed.
component_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table component. Clean lines, text-left alignment.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select components. Customise with standard border and focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
component_instructions.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for Add/Edit costume forms.
component_instructions.buttons: Flat design, rounded-md, distinct primary and secondary variants.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

logo.description: Abstract corporate brand logo for header

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a clean, corporate dashboard layout. Create a dashboard summary view, an inventory list (with toggleable grid/table views), and an add/edit form (Shadcn Dialog). Ensure all mock data utilizes the provided image URLs. Ensure the application adheres to the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Enforce data-testid on every interactive element.
